record.field: Sent after checkout to guests who asked for an account

div.p: Thanks for your order S00042! You asked us to create an account so you can track your orders.
Confirm your email and choose a password to activate it:

a.t-attf-style: display: inline-block; padding: 12px 24px; text-decoration: none; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px; background-color: {{ object.company_id.email_secondary_color or '#3a4efd' }}; color: {{ object.company_id.email_primary_color or '#FFFFFF' }};

div.p:
This link expires in a few days. If it has, use "Reset password" on the login page with this email address.
Didn't ask for an account? You can ignore this email.
